entries.title: Psalms 102:1
segments: <<A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is aoverwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah.>> Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And let my cry come unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 102:2
segments: Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress: Incline thine ear unto me; In the day when I call answer me speedily.

entries.title: Psalms 102:3
segments: For my days consume away  like smoke, And my bones are burned  as a firebrand.

entries.title: Psalms 102:4
segments: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; For I forget to eat my bread.

entries.title: Psalms 102:5
segments: By reason of the voice of my groaning My bones cleave to my flesh.

entries.title: Psalms 102:6
segments: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.

entries.title: Psalms 102:7
segments: I watch, and am become like a sparrow That is alone upon the house-top.

entries.title: Psalms 102:8
segments: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; They that are mad against me do curse by me.

entries.title: Psalms 102:9
segments: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,

entries.title: Psalms 102:10
segments: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: For thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.

entries.title: Psalms 102:11
segments: My days are like a shadow that  declineth; And I am withered like grass.

entries.title: Psalms 102:12
segments: But thou, O Jehovah,  wilt abide for ever; And thy memorial [name] unto all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 102:13
segments: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to have pity upon her, Yea, the set time is come.

entries.title: Psalms 102:14
segments: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, And have pity upon her dust.

entries.title: Psalms 102:15
segments: So the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.

entries.title: Psalms 102:16
segments: For Jehovah hath built up Zion; He hath appeared in his glory.

entries.title: Psalms 102:17
segments: He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 102:18
segments: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise  Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 102:19
segments: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; From heaven did Jehovah behold the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 102:20
segments: To hear the sighing of the prisoner; To loose  those that are appointed to death;

entries.title: Psalms 102:21
segments: That men may declare the name of Jehovah in Zion, And his praise in Jerusalem;

entries.title: Psalms 102:22
segments: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 102:23
segments: He  weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

entries.title: Psalms 102:24
segments: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thy years are throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 102:25
segments: Of old didst thou lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of thy hands.

entries.title: Psalms 102:26
segments: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

entries.title: Psalms 102:27
segments: But thou art the same, And thy years shall have no end.

entries.title: Psalms 102:28
segments: The children of thy servants shall continue, And their seed shall be established before thee.
